verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI documents LLM-based structured extraction that works with any LLM, as an alternative to CSS/XPath selectors. The CLI also accepts a natural-language query (`-q "Extract all product prices"`), so the LLM chooses what to pull without hand-written selectors, and LLMTableExtraction extends this to tables. Missing for 10: no in-depth docs showing the LLM inferring the field schema on its own (the schema feature implies user-defined schemas), no evidence on output quality or reliability, and no independent or hands-on corroboration.
